URL and URLSearchParams (WHATWG URL Standard) as host objects. A URL's searchParams is linked to it both ways: changing the URL's search re-parses the list, changing the list rewrites the URL's query. Either may be released first.

Exposed to: Window, Worker. Source: api/url.widl.

Odin: import "wren:url".

#URL_set

void URL_set(URL url, URLComponent component, string value) raises

A setter. Only href can fail (Type); values the standard ignores leave the URL unchanged. Origin is read-only (Invalid_Argument).

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

#URLPattern_execString

i32 URLPattern_execString(URLPattern pattern, string input, string base, bool has_base)

Run exec()/test() against a URL string (resolved against base when has_base). Stores the result in the object. Returns 1 when it matched, 0 when it did not (exec returns null, test returns false).

Host: URLPattern_execString :: proc(c: ^Call, pattern: Api_URLPattern, input: string, base: string, has_base: bool) -> i32
